text: A lantern lit. The Manner begins.
Survey stakes and new rows — plus a timber cache.
The east field opens — plus a granary share.
The whole hollow is yours — plus moonstone from the deep store.
A stockade cache: timber and moonstone for proven hands.
A harvest blessing: full tables, heavy coffers.
A legend stash: the frontier pays its debt.
Siege-craft cache: full tables, heavy coffers, and the high towers open their fourth tier.
